output.summary: A perennial shrub native to California and the Baja California Peninsula, bladderpod bears bright yellow flowers nearly year-round and leathery pods. Indigenous tribes ate seeds and flowers after boiling or other cooking, while the Cahuilla cooked immature pods with hot stones; immature pods are edible in small quantities.
output.edibilityNote: Seeds and flowers were eaten after cooking; Cahuilla cooked immature pods with hot stones, and immature pods are edible only in small quantities.
